summary: Modal, non-modal or alert dialog on the native dialog element, with title, body and footer slots.

usage.text: Nothing opens it for you: set the open attribute or call show(). Close with hide(returnValue?) or by removing the attribute. Buttons in the footer slot need their own click handlers.

The type attribute is modal (default, uses showModal()), non-modal (uses show()) or alert (role alertdialog, described by its body, closedby="none"). The padding attribute is none, small, medium or large.

The built-in close button and Escape fire a cancelable request-close event with detail.source (close-button or keyboard); preventDefault() keeps the dialog open. hide() and changes to the open attribute skip it.

a11y.text: Content in the title slot is the accessible name. Without it the dialog is named "Dialog"; an aria-label on the host is not used.
On close, focus returns to the element that had focus when the dialog opened.
